sloka: ब्राह्मणो ह्येकपार्श्वेन नरान् रोद्धुमिहार्हति ।न तु मूर्द्धाभिषिक्तानां विधि: प्रत्युपवेशने ॥ २.१११.१७॥
transliteration: brāhmaṇo hyekapārśvena narān roddhumihārhati ।na tu mūrddhābhiṣiktānāṁ vidhi: pratyupaveśane ॥ 2.111.17॥

translations.english: A brahmin alone is competent in this world to prevent a person by lying down on one side (in front of him). One who is anointed king is not permitted by (scriptural) tradition to squat in protest.
